task.description:
WF-02, step 1c — rework of the design of REQ-106 (docs/design/REQ-106-e2e-pixel-office.md) by the findings of the gate, pass 1 (handoffs/E2E106-20261115-01/step-01b-code-design-validator.json: F1 High, F2 Medium, F3-F13 Low), and only by them (AP-019). The gate's re-check is pass 2 of 3.

(F1, High) R2 by construction: every call of the design that is given the owner's real home folder or the real state folder of this computer — in the starter's refusals, in the hook helper's refusals, in test 1 'isolated start', in BACKEND-DEV's own check of sub-step 1 (b), in any mutant of rule P or of the hook helper's checks — uses an injected spawn that records the call and throws, so that no regression and no mutant can start a process on the real folders; say so in 4.4 (a), in 14 sub-step 1 (b) and in the R2 rule of section 16 (extended to the mutants of rule P and of the hook helper's checks), and correct F29. In your own sketch your mutant R02 ran the real hook with the real state folder (gate issue I1, mutant_product line 45): the hook read the secret and the port file and wrote nothing only because no server listened. Write in result.issues exactly what that trial did, with the evidence, and confirm with sha256, size and time of all five files of the real folder that nothing changed; from now on any call of yours that names a real folder goes only to a spawn that records and throws. (F2, Medium) Step (3) of rule P ('outside the repository') must be pinned: a starter test run with the temporary root set to a folder that contains the repository (a clone of the tag under a temporary folder, or an injected root), with a refusing spawn, expects PATH_REFUSED 'inside the repository' and 0 spawns; add the test and the mutant (step 3 removed) with the test that catches it. (F3-F13, Low) Settle each in the design as the gate proposes or say why not: F3 the 'X=<path>' form inside env values, F4 the precedence STAND_HOME_WRITTEN over STAND_STOP_TIMEOUT and STAND_EXIT (decisions/0112 О1), F5 a folder made in the home (not only a file), F6 the temporary root refused in every spelling (trailing slash, '.', real path), F7 the stand-in's write-home guard, F8 the outcomes of reconnect told apart by the start-row count (not the port file) and outcome (iii) named honestly, F9 the four more scans of tools/test in section 12, F10 the missing USAGE messages of stateEnv, F11 the words '<real home>' made unambiguous, F12 the reading of 'HOME folder of the spec' in criterion 5 named, F13 section 7 names the ci/ branch run before the push (decisions/0110). Each new or changed test gets its mutant. Also write into the design, for TEST-DESIGNER, the kit trap of gate issue I3: page.waitFor with a function source and no args evaluates the function itself as true and ends at once.

R2 for your trials, as before and stricter: never start Pixel Office or its hook against the real state folder or the real home; record sha256, size and time of all five files of the real folder before your first trial and after your last. Change only the design (and your handoff); no commit, push or pull. The text holds no absolute machine paths, no temporary paths and no names of other projects of the owner.

result.summary: Rework of the design of REQ-106 by the findings F1-F13 of gate pass 1 (and its issues I1, I3), only by them. F1 (High): a new rule R2-S (design section 6) — every call that is given the person's real home folder or the real Pixel Office state folder (the refusals of startStand and runHook in test 'isolated start', E2S-03, BACKEND-DEV's own check (b), and every run of a mutant of rule P or of runHook's checks) gets a deps.spawn that records its arguments and throws, never the real spawn and never a counting wrapper of it; E2S-05 now sets its own HOME to a decoy folder of the test; the series rule of section 16 is extended to the mutants of rule P and of the hook helper; R09 (the real spawn in a refusal) is on record and never applied. The breach of step 01 is described with evidence (F31): the mutant R02 ran the real hook program once with SAI_PIXEL_OFFICE_DIR = the real state folder; it read node-path, write-secret and port and posted to 127.0.0.1:4780, the connection was refused, nothing was written; all five real files are unchanged (F32). R02 was applied again with the throwing spawn: red, 'a real folder reached the spawn', no process. F2 (Medium): new starter test E2S-22 pins step 3 of rule P ('outside the repository') with a copy of the four kit files under the temporary root, so the copied kit takes the copy for the repository; mutant S19 red. F3-F13 settled as the gate proposed, each new or changed test with its mutant (S20-S26, P35), and the kit trap of I3 written for TEST-DESIGNER. Measured on the prototype: the starter tests 22 of 22, all 26 starter mutants red, P35 red, the spec green (22053 ms), the full suite 2209 of 2209.

issues.text: What my mutant R02 of step 01 did (gate F1, issue I1). In the prototype (<outside the project>/e2e106-01/proto/tools/test/e2e/pixel-office.e2e.js) the refusal call runHook(start('x', ROLE_A), { office: <the real state folder>, home: <the temporary root> }) passed no injected spawn. The mutant R02 (<outside the project>/e2e106-01/sk/mut_product.py, row R02) removed the two folder checks of runHook, and the harness ran 'isolated start' alone once, about 2026-11-15T18:35Z (mut_product.out, line 29: 'R02 RED … 0.2s … Missing expected rejection.'). So /bin/sh src/pixel-office/hook.sh (of the proto clone) ran once with SAI_PIXEL_OFFICE_DIR = the real state folder of this computer, HOME = the temporary root, PATH, and the invented payload SubagentStart of session e2e106-sess-0001, agent x, agent_type 'Sai Code Designer (CODE-DESIGNER)'. By the code of hook.sh and hook.js it read the real node-path and started that Node, read the real write-secret and port (4780), signed the body and posted it to 127.0.0.1:4780; the connection was refused because no Pixel Office server of the owner was running (now too: lsof on 4780 -> no line), and the hook ended with code 0. The hook writes no file. Evidence that nothing changed: the five files have the same sha256, size and time of last change before step 01, after it (step 01 self_check for events.jsonl and server-starts.jsonl), at the start of step 01c and after it (self_check above, all five); events.jsonl last changed on 2026-10-29. With the owner's server running, the event would have been signed with the real secret and appended to the owner's journal. It broke the rule of the task of step 01. No other call of step 01 gave a real folder to a real spawn (the starter refusals used a throwing spawn; E2S-03 uses countingSpawn(refusingSpawn); under S01, S02 the stand-in's home lookup was the person's home and its guard wrote nothing there). From step 01c on every call of mine that names a real folder goes only to a spawn that records and throws, and the design makes it rule R2-S.

For docs/anti-patterns.md (ORCH decides, as the gate's I1 says): a prototype departed from its own design's R2 seam (a refusal call that names a real folder left on the real spawn), and its own mutant of the check then started the hook on the owner's folder; a series rule written for product and starter mutants missed the mutants of the spec's own checks. The right way: a call that names a real folder always gets a spawn that records and throws, written as a rule of the design (R2-S) and checked by a search before each mutant run. Also the kit trap of gate I3 (waitFor with a function source and no args).

E2S-22 copies four released kit files (stand.js, cleanup.js, errors.js, guards.js) into a folder of the test; if a later change makes stand.js import another kit file, E2S-22 must copy it too (the child then fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND, which is red, not a silent pass).
